disposition_reason: Table 1 prints category mean ± SD (mg/l) of Mn, Cr, Cd, Zn, Co, Cu, Fe and Pb for seven non-alcoholic beverage categories bought in Aba, Nigeria.

study.design: Market survey; 40 non-alcoholic drink samples (bottled water, wines, juices, yogurt, carbonated drinks, malt and tea) from supermarkets; results reported as 7 category means
study.market: supermarket outlets in Aba and environs, Abia State, Nigeria
study.method: Flame AAS (Agilent 280FS AA) after HNO3/HCl/HClO4 (3:1:1) wet digestion of 5 mL sample at 250 °C
study.qa: Spike recovery at 0.5 mg/L: Mn 90, Cr 93, Cd 91, Zn 89, Co 96, Cu 99, Fe 97, Pb 101%; calibration and rinse blanks; no CRM
